item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1812] Editor code is not visible after page refresh.
item.description: After a notebook has been created and the page refreshed the editor code is no longer visible when clicking the show/hide editor button. If you click "Show Editor" and then refresh the page, the editor code is shown again.
item.summary: Editor code is not visible after page refresh.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Detailed step to reproduce:
1. Hide editor
2. refresh page
3. Show editor
4. Editor won't show up

This seems to happen after ace editor version upgrade
(https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1692)

GitHub user cloverhearts opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1848

ZEPPELIN-1812 Ace editor show/hide problem.

      1. What is this PR for?
        When editor hide is on and page refresh then editor is gone.
        I was solve this problem.
      1. What type of PR is it?
        Bug Fix
      1. What is the Jira issue?
        https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-1812
      1. How should this be tested?
        1. hide to editor mode on in paragraph configure.
        2. page refresh (f5)
        3. enable to show editor mode in paragraph configure.
        4. if show editor then is correct.
      2. Screenshots (if appropriate)
        1. before
          ![badeditor](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/10525473/21677078/62136de2-d2ed-11e6-9418-0be4453fd839.gif)
        1. after
          ![goodeditor](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/10525473/21677092/6c8d97e8-d2ed-11e6-8966-a3b7af60c231.gif)
